items.title: Constant-dimensional generalized Sylvester-Gallai configurations of quadratic polynomials
items.author: Shir Peleg; Amir Shpilka
items.source_version: CCC2020 published33-page version plus paired journal2022 published29-page structural-proof continuation
items.difficulty_reason: The author combines a resultant classification of two-quadratic radical ideals with robust incidence geometry and projection maps; the main proof handles global pair distributions and high/low-rank product-dominated configurations. These are explicit nonroutine algebraic/geometric mechanisms.
